devops_intro: I treat GitLab CI/CD as a first-class deliverable. Every project ships with a hermetic build, a test matrix, static-analysis gates, and a Pages preview — wired to merge-request rules so reviewers see green before the diff.
devops_c1_body: Reproducible via Nix Flakes — same artefact on a developer laptop and the runner. No "works on my machine".
devops_c2_body: Axivion for AUTOSAR / MISRA / ISO 26262, clang-tidy for general hygiene. Fails the MR on any critical violation.
devops_c3_body: Google Test suites with gcov reports surfaced on the MR widget. Floor at 85% on safety-critical paths.
devops_c4_body: Branch-scoped GitLab Pages environments for docs and dashboards per MR.
